selected_evidence.summary: The passwd entry, UID/GID, login shell, home directory, ownership, and mode were verified before and after restart.

selected_evidence.requirement: appworker login sessions are limited to 8,192 open files and 256 processes
selected_evidence.summary: The persistent PAM limits file contains matching soft and hard limits; fresh appworker login sessions directly reported 8192/8192 open-file and 256/256 process limits before and after restart.

Captured healthy baseline boot ID 953e6cb5-ce48-44db-bc5a-32edac59aac5, acknowledged the scheduled native systemd reboot, observed changed boot ID cfc13ec2-b8d7-473e-960e-3de36ce0f05d, then verified running system state, zero failed units, active login service, persistent account data, and effective limits.

commands.command:
set -eu
printf 'node=%s ip=%s\n' "$NODE_NAME" "$NODE_IP"
printf 'os='
. /etc/os-release
printf '%s %s\n' "$ID" "$VERSION_ID"
printf 'boot_id='
cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id
if id appworker >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  id appworker
  getent passwd appworker
else
  printf 'appworker=absent\n'
fi
printf 'limits_files:\n'
find /etc/security/limits.d -maxdepth 1 -type f -print 2>/dev/null | sort
printf 'pam_limits_refs:\n'
grep -R '^[[:space:]]*session[[:space:]].*pam_limits\.so' /etc/pam.d 2>/dev/null | head -20 || true
printf 'failed_units:\n'
systemctl --failed --no-legend --plain || true
printf 'rootfs:\n'
findmnt -n -o TARGET,SOURCE,FSTYPE,OPTIONS /
printf 'uptime_seconds='
cut -d. -f1 /proc/uptime
commands.stdout:
node=node1 ip=10.100.145.10
os=rhel 8.8
boot_id=953e6cb5-ce48-44db-bc5a-32edac59aac5
appworker=absent

pam_limits_refs:
/etc/pam.d/fingerprint-auth:session     required      pam_limits.so

/etc/pam.d/system-auth:session     required      pam_limits.so

failed_units:
rootfs:

uptime_seconds=83

commands.command:
set -eu
if ! id appworker >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  /usr/sbin/useradd --create-home --shell /bin/bash appworker
fi
id appworker
getent passwd appworker
test -d /home/appworker
stat -c 'home=%n owner=%U group=%G mode=%a' /home/appworker
commands.stdout:
uid=1000(appworker) gid=1000(appworker) groups=1000(appworker)
appworker:x:1000:1000::/home/appworker:/bin/bash
home=/home/appworker owner=appworker group=appworker mode=700

commands.command:
set -eu
tmp_file=$(mktemp /etc/security/limits.d/.appworker.conf.XXXXXX)
printf '%s\n' \
  '# Managed account limits for appworker' \
  'appworker soft nofile 8192' \
  'appworker hard nofile 8192' \
  'appworker soft nproc 256' \
  'appworker hard nproc 256' > "$tmp_file"
chown root:root "$tmp_file"
chmod 0644 "$tmp_file"
mv -f "$tmp_file" /etc/security/limits.d/appworker.conf
restorecon /etc/security/limits.d/appworker.conf 2>/dev/null || true
stat -c 'file=%n owner=%U group=%G mode=%a' /etc/security/limits.d/appworker.conf
printf 'content:\n'
sed -n '1,20p' /etc/security/limits.d/appworker.conf
commands.stdout:
file=/etc/security/limits.d/appworker.conf owner=root group=root mode=644
content:
# Managed account limits for appworker
appworker soft nofile 8192
appworker hard nofile 8192
appworker soft nproc 256
appworker hard nproc 256

commands.command:
set -eu
printf 'pam_su_stack:\n'
grep -E '^[[:space:]]*(session|auth|account).*system-auth|pam_limits\.so' /etc/pam.d/su /etc/pam.d/system-auth || true
printf 'fresh_login_session:\n'
/bin/su - appworker -c 'printf "user=%s uid=%s shell=%s pid=%s\n" "$USER" "$(id -u)" "$SHELL" "$$"; grep -E "^Max processes|^Max open files" /proc/$$/limits'
commands.stdout:

/etc/pam.d/su:auth		substack	system-auth

/etc/pam.d/su:session		include		system-auth
/etc/pam.d/system-auth:session     required      pam_limits.so
fresh_login_session:
user=appworker uid=1000 shell=/bin/bash pid=1481
